Question: What happens if I don't activate a roaming pack and use my phone abroad?

Answer: You will be billed at standard (non-discounted) per-minute/per-MB roaming tariffs, which are significantly higher than pack rates. We strongly recommend activating a pack in advance; emergency top-up roaming packs can also be purchased via SMS while abroad where supported.
